evidence.scope: Delivery accounting only; disabled audio is discarded, not a new listening/waveform acceptance.

motion.attachment: RGBA16F: unjittered UV velocity.xy, previous linear depth, MSAA coverage; R16F: current linear depth; normalize both by coverage
limits: analytic rest-mesh wind and camera motion only; no arbitrary model-matrix animation
missing-coverage bridge retains conservative camera-only fallback

bloom.model: single threshold-free linear HDR PSF; opt-in affine ghost/veil share at most 1.8% radiance redistribution
bloom.flareScope: visible input image only; finite sensor crop, no offscreen-source/lens-tracing/occlusion inference

hdr.shoulder: same fitted SDR ACES anchor through exposed peak 1; C1 bounded highlight extension; nit scale divided by browser/Windows SDR white
hdr.limits: System-reported luminance is not a photometer measurement and scene lux is not calibrated. This is not an official ACES HDR ODT. Extended sRGB canvas is not a native 80-nit scRGB swap chain. External-image copy is not guaranteed zero-copy. PBO copies pixels through CPU. HDR enlargement is linear, not SDR FSR1.

lens.antialias: MSAA + leaf temporal + water temporal + SMAA

temporal.scope: analytic wind/camera foliage motion, MSAA coverage, independent short water radiance history
temporal.metadata: R8 age; nearest valid depth, bilinear RGB

photometry.reference: 3.6 relative directional irradiance per100000 reference lux; effective, not measured
limits: Source bounds must cover all participating RGB channels and worst relevant overlap.
Finite FP16 storage and final display dynamic range are different constraints.
A changed storage exposure does not change photographic exposure.

frame.reference: 3.6 relative directional irradiance per100000 reference lux; effective, not measured
limits: Source bounds must cover all participating RGB channels and worst relevant overlap.
Finite FP16 storage and final display dynamic range are different constraints.
A changed storage exposure does not change photographic exposure.

weather.model: prescribed moist parcel LCL plus kinematic cumulus; no atmospheric fluid/forecast solve

limits: Snapshot coherence, not instantaneous sky; cube/PMREM age are explicit
Sky cubemap is captured at one fixed point per round, not a spatial radiance field
Source bound is atmosphere analytic envelope; not photometer calibration
Explicit initialize/refresh draws six faces synchronously; scheduled work is face-budgeted
No CPU/GPU timing or FPS claim

limits: authored reference material, not measured kg/PM or per-star yield

limits: no app/event/source integration
true finite Gaussian columns withFloat32/erf and finite proxy-tail error; no unbiased-renderer claim
back-to-front latent-centre order; S at optical conditional mean, overlapping/source-varying scattering is approximate
optional four-cell front-air T/S restores front in-scatter at a conditional-mean thin layer; overlapping volumes are not a joint RTE integration
optional shared6 localIncident sources replace legacy2 clusters; borrowed stored RGB is not multiplied by P again
no smoke self-shadow, smoke source-path attenuation or multiple scattering; shared torch scene-shadow PCF is reused when active
air is sun/key-only, exponential height, flat local worldY clamped at0; no smoke/local-light sourced air illumination added by this module
opaque depth must be independently resolved; no centre-depth discard
whole-space Gaussian matches state; no ground-fold/deposition model implicitly applied
no density/P/C coupling; P applied once to own raw lighting including air, borrowed local uniforms must already match this frame P
proxy culling affects rendering only; physical state mass is never deleted
far/subpixel footprint filtering and volumeDOF are not solved; per-source PSF remains caller-owned

Whole-space neutral Gaussian medium; scattering, overlap order and clear-air folding retain the renderer StageA approximations.

bound.limits: Bound for normalized isotropic Gaussian packet/emitter SH1 model only. No incoming smoke shadow, anisotropic conditional-ray field, scene-wide energy conservation, packet-count multiplier or measured photometry.

true finite Gaussian columns withFloat32/erf and finite proxy-tail error; no unbiased-renderer claim
back-to-front latent-centre order; S at optical conditional mean, overlapping/source-varying scattering is approximate
optional four-cell front-air T/S restores front in-scatter at a conditional-mean thin layer; overlapping volumes are not a joint RTE integration
optional shared6 localIncident sources replace legacy2 clusters; borrowed stored RGB is not multiplied by P again
no smoke self-shadow, smoke source-path attenuation or multiple scattering; shared torch scene-shadow PCF is reused when active
air is sun/key-only, exponential height, flat local worldY clamped at0; no smoke/local-light sourced air illumination added by this module
opaque depth must be independently resolved; no centre-depth discard
whole-space Gaussian matches state; no ground-fold/deposition model implicitly applied
no density/P/C coupling; P applied once to own raw lighting including air, borrowed local uniforms must already match this frame P
proxy culling affects rendering only; physical state mass is never deleted
far/subpixel footprint filtering and volumeDOF are not solved; per-source PSF remains caller-owned
Physical transport uses fixed20Hz state commits; it is not a fluid/turbulence/settling solver.
Source-path extinction is queried at emitter/tail anchors; it is not exact per-pixel convolution through a varying medium.
Whole-space neutral Gaussian medium; scattering, overlap order and clear-air folding retain the renderer StageA approximations.
Technical gates do not accept photographic appearance; actual PNGs need review.
One actual event feeds both hosts, light/audio only once. Two source geometries legitimately differ, no identical-image claim.
Uniform authored life release and fan mouth/comet split are not measured chemistry/yield. Reference total is not calibrated kg/PM.
The original production host is separately restored by the caller; explicit clear and physical elapsed time cannot be rewound.
No lighting/source intensity or C compensation; independently safe P can differ per host.
No smoke self-shadow/multiple-scattering/CFD or per-star fluid-grid claim.

trace.errorPolicy: Each reached application GL operation executes once. Native getError is drained after operations; unique pending flags are replayed to application getError. Undelivered virtual flags are reported at cleanup and cannot be restored to native GL without manufacturing errors.
limits: Probing changes synchronization, error observation timing and CPU cost; this is diagnosis, not performance or error-free acceptance.
Only calls reached through wrapped context properties are observed. Previously captured native references and extension-object methods can bypass wrapping.
First observed post-operation errors are attribution candidates; preexisting flags and helper metadata operations are labelled separately.
Caller must exclusively own the one-shot frame probe slot. requestFrame registers a callback; it must not render. A pending owned callback is cleared on cleanup.
Timeout is checked synchronously but JavaScript cannot interrupt a native call or an executing frame; cleanup occurs when control returns.
